name: crm-all-suite
description: Unified runner for CRM nErgy AI and Worksuite CRM

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "CRM-FRONT,CRM-BACK,WORK-FRONT,WORK-BACK" -c "cyan,blue,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix crm-frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend-crm" "npm run dev --prefix crm-worksuite-frontend" "npm run dev --prefix crm-worksuite-backend"
scripts.dev:crm: concurrently -n "CRM-FRONT,CRM-BACK" -c "cyan,blue" "npm run dev --prefix crm-frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend-crm"
scripts.dev:worksuite: concurrently -n "WORK-FRONT,WORK-BACK" -c "magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix crm-worksuite-frontend" "npm run dev --prefix crm-worksuite-backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix crm-frontend && npm install --prefix backend-crm && npm install --prefix crm-worksuite-frontend && npm install --prefix crm-worksuite-backend
